title: The ORCH PM's own context budget (Story 1.5, lane D)
summary: Final lane of the frozen Story 1.5: define a provided pm/usage.json observation contract for final-context occupancy, evaluate and render the coordinator's context budget from a PM stamp or adapter observation, write secret-free PM checkpoint and continuation artifacts atomically, surface a loud PM_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED condition without ever launching a PM session, reconcile a human-started successor while leaving worker watches untouched, and document the PM discipline and lifecycle contract. The work adds lifecycle command, status, reconciliation, documentation, and test coverage; it must preserve worker dispatch behavior and all frozen harness launch text. Judgment calls include schema validation, redaction, atomic settlement, and precedence. A wrong result could hide a required coordinator handoff or disturb live worker orchestration, but handles no credential values.
